about: Portability fixes for platforms v1.0.11 never compiled (fold step B6). Each file is pinned to its reviewed bytes (whitespace-insensitive sha256, equivalence.py closure_digest); level 1 and the closure check compare against that instead of the shipped bytes. Each listed TU's Linux tokens change, so level 3 must find its objects identical.

runtime-recomp/src/game/achievements.cpp.reason: libc++ (Apple, Android) lacks std::atomic<std::shared_ptr>; uses dkr::runtime::AtomicSnapshot (atomic_snapshot.hpp), the same type on libstdc++ and MSVC.

runtime-recomp/src/game/f3ddkr_rt64.cpp.reason: Metal builds have no enhanced-water renderer; the water_residency_rt64.hpp include is skipped under __APPLE__ (token-identical elsewhere).
